# Cincy Crash Data

```{r cincy_crashes}
crashes_per_day = 30125 / 365
crashes_per_day

crashes_by_day = c(2020, 2241, 2327, 2285,
                   2380, 1866, 1664)
names(crashes_by_day) = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu",
                          "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")
crashes_by_day

crashes_by_day > 2100
```
